identitySignals: Name matches: 'Project Support Services' (psscert.com), a firm specializing in Division of State Architecture (DSA) certification and closeout for California school construction, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' / Facilities Planning and Management contract
The company lists an Oakland office at 505 14th St, #900, Oakland, CA 94612 and says it has worked with more than 50 school districts

Third-party business directories (not cited) list a Project Support Services, Inc. address in Orange, CA, matching the agenda location, but the company's own website gives its main office as Corona, CA
research.notes: Agenda gives Orange, CA; the company website lists its main office in Corona, CA (plus an Oakland office). Directories list an Orange, CA address (293 N State College Blvd Ste 1079) that could not be confirmed on an official or registry page. No CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov record or OUSD mention was verified, so the match is not confirmed at high confidence. Only a named person's email was shown, so email omitted.

profile.address: 9036 Pulsar Court, Suite B, Corona, CA 92883
profile.summary: Project Support Services is a project management firm that helps California school districts and design professionals with Division of State Architecture (DSA) rules. It handles DSA certification and closeout of school construction projects, document archiving and training on DSA processes.
